ADÉLA vs Olivia Dean, by the numbers (Spotify, as of Oct 20, 2026): ADÉLA adds 561K monthly listeners a day to Dean's 165K, and her "Nicole Kidman" is #1 on the US weekly chart (8.8M streams, week of Oct 15) with "Ain't In LA" at #3 worldwide.

Dean still leads on listeners (52.4M vs 39.9M) and lifetime streams (9.3B vs 826.5M), and "Man I Need" is #17 globally after 60 weeks on the chart.

Whose breakout is bigger? 👇
